description: This Kotlin source file defines a class 'BiometricAuthenticator' that provides a wrapper around Android's BiometricPrompt API for biometric authentication. It includes methods to check device biometric availability and to show a biometric prompt to the user, supporting fallback to device credentials like PIN or passcode.

classes.name: BiometricAuthenticator
classes.description: A wrapper class to handle biometric authentication, checking availability and showing prompts with device credential fallback.

classes.name: BiometricAuthenticator.Availability
classes.description: Sealed class representing whether biometric authentication is available or not, with associated reasons.

methods.name: availability
methods.description: Checks if biometric or device credential authentication is available on the device.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Displays a biometric prompt to the user with specified title and subtitle, and handles success, failure, and errors via callbacks.
